title: Knowledge graph L1: Schedule entry
description: One row of a schedule: which intervention, for whom, when, how many doses. This is the granularity a decision table actually consumes — the BCG rules turn on dose count, age and interval since a live vaccine. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/schedule-entry.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGScheduleEntry logical model

antigen.description: The antigen or vaccine the row is about.

doseNumber.description: Dose in the series as printed ("1", "Booster 1"). Text, because schedules label boosters rather than count them.

series.description: Primary series or booster series, as stated.

targetAge.description: Age at which the dose is due, as stated.

minimumInterval.description: Minimum interval since the previous dose, as stated.

note.description: The row's footnote or remark, verbatim.
